name: Speedtest Tracker
tagline: Track your internet speed over time
description: Continuously runs Ookla speedtests and charts latency, download and upload history — perfect evidence for ISP complaints.
compose:
services:
  speedtest:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/speedtest-tracker:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
